title: 3 AI Agents Argue and Beat Any Single AI on Accuracy
description:
Comment "DEBATE" and we'll send you the setup guide.

We made three AI agents argue with each other, and the final answer came out more accurate than what any solo agent produced.

One AI answers. Second tears it apart. First defends and rewrites. A few rounds. Third AI plays judge. A 2026 study showed 4 to 6% accuracy boost and 30% fewer hallucinations.

The wild part, they change their mind mid-debate. No ego. Can't say the same about people on Twitter.

#aiagents #claudeai #aitools #aitok #multiagent
transcript: We made three EI agents argue with each other and the final answer came out more accurate than what any of them produced alone. The logic is simple. One AI answers, the second one reads it and [music] tears the answer apart looking for holes, inconsistencies. The first one defends itself, rewrites [music] a few rounds. At the end, a third AI plays judge and picks the best one. A 2026 study showed a 4 to 6% accuracy boost and 30% and fewer hallucinated facts. I test AI tools every single day and solo agents run out of steam on the hard stuff fast. [music] I built my own system. It's called Aries, Adversarial Reasoning Engine System. Inside it, three agents argue with each other over every decision. The wild part is they actually change their mind mid debate. One says [music] A, the other brings a counter argument and the first one just admits it [music] was wrong. No ego. Can't say the same about people on Twitter. >> comment debate below and we will send you a setup guide for running three arguing AI agents.
